vibe: Bold editorial / magazine-style, confident, authoritative, artistic yet technical.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing, Asymmetry, Grid Borders, Massive Typography, High Contrast.
spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento Grid (Tetris) for Projects, strict table grids for Admin Dashboard.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Left-aligned dominant, optical alignment for icons.
spacing_and_layout.borders: Expose the skeleton for tech sections. 1px solid #E5E7EB for technical data, borders completely removed for editorial text sections.

components_strategy.marketing_pages: Pure HTML/Tailwind for layouts, overlapping elements. Framer Motion for scroll triggers.
components_strategy.admin_dashboard: Shadcn UI (Tables, Dialogs, Cards, Forms). Sharp edges, dense data, monochrome with red accents.
components_strategy.buttons: Editorial style: hard rectangles, 0px border-radius, pure black background, white text. Hover: pure red background.

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Images go from grayscale to full color on hover. Text links get a thick red underline.
motion_and_interaction.scroll_effects: Lenis smooth scrolling mandatory. Parallax on hero image.
motion_and_interaction.page_transitions: Staggered fade-in for massive typography lines.

hero.layout: Massive typography 'TALHA KENAN' taking 90% of screen width. Mixed italic and standard fonts. Overlapping 'hero_abstract' image on the right edge. 'Developer / Engineer' label.
hero.visuals: hero_abstract image as a dramatic architectural accent, parallaxing behind or beside text.

about.layout: Grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12. Portrait ('about_portrait') spanning 5 columns. Bio text spanning 6 columns with massive H2. Skills listed as an 'Editorial Ribbon' or clean lowercase list.

projects.layout: Asymmetric Bento Grid or massive stacked rows. Large images (project_placeholder). Clicking goes to detail page. Hover states are critical (grayscale to color).

contact.layout: High-contrast form. Huge 'Let's Talk' H2. Real form using Shadcn inputs (heavily styled: border-b only, no full boxes). Form sends via Resend.
contact.visuals: contact_footer image as a background accent.

admin_login.layout: Minimalist center card. High contrast, pure black button.

admin_dashboard.layout: Control Room Grid. Sidebar navigation. Tables for CRUD projects, forms for editing site content.
admin_dashboard.components: Shadcn Data Tables, Dialogs, Tabs, Forms.

images.description: Abstract architectural composition for hero section backdrop or accent.
Moody, cinematic portrait of Talha Kenan in a modern studio.
Abstract digital UI/UX art for project thumbnails.
Architectural modern workspace for footer/contact area visual anchor.

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid. Examples: data-testid='contact-submit-button', data-testid='admin-login-button'.
